summary: Layer 1B expanded the universe around schedule-critical electrical power-distribution equipment for data centers, industrial electrification, utilities, microgrids, renewables and power-quality needs. The strongest underfollowed candidates are not GPU or utility-generation names, but companies making or distributing medium-voltage equipment, dry-type transformers, transmission hardware, and electrical distribution systems. Reference mega-cap exposure exists through Eaton, but the more Serenity-relevant discovery lane includes Powell Industries, Hammond Power Solutions via OTC HMDPF, and Preformed Line Products.
